About.sectionSubtitle: 8+ years building systems that scale, perform, and last.
About.p1: I'm a Senior .NET Engineer with deep experience across fintech, logistics, and enterprise SaaS. I've led platform migrations, designed event-driven microservices, and shipped products used by hundreds of thousands of users.
About.p2: My core stack is .NET/C# on the backend and Next.js/TypeScript on the frontend, grounded in Clean Architecture and DDD. I think about seams, observability, and reversibility — not as abstract principles, but because they make teams measurably faster over time.
About.p3: Based in the Netherlands. I work in English, Arabic, and Dutch. I'm interested in how AI tooling amplifies individual engineering leverage — this portfolio is an experiment in exactly that.
